findings.explanation: docs/index.md states that kebab case for CLI arguments is enabled by default, but the code sets cli_kebab_case to False by default.

doc_citation.quote:
#### CLI Kebab Case for Arguments

Change whether CLI arguments should use kebab case by enabling `cli_kebab_case`. By default, `cli_kebab_case=True` will
ignore enum fields, and is equivalent to `cli_kebab_case='no_enums'`. To apply kebab case to everything, including
enums, use `cli_kebab_case='all'`.

findings.proposed_fix: In docs/index.md, replace the default claim with documentation-only text: "Change whether CLI arguments should use kebab case by enabling `cli_kebab_case`. By default, `cli_kebab_case=False`, so arguments use the declared field names. When enabled, `cli_kebab_case=True` ignores enum fields and is equivalent to `cli_kebab_case='no_enums'`. To apply kebab case to everything, including enums, use `cli_kebab_case='all'`."
